name: player_update_camera_weather_fx_emitter_visibility
description: Player::UpdateCameraWeatherFxEmitterVisibility updates the pass-3 weather FX emitter visibility from player camera state, sub-mode, camera occlusion, and replicate mode.
known_limits: Binary Ninja disassembly/HLIL for 0x406610 validates the null fxPass3Obj early return, SUB-mode hide path, non-SUB gwCameraGetTarget, root raycast disable/restore, SetStopAfterFirstHit(0x40000), SetBreakOnFirstCandidate(1/0), RaycastFindClosest from camera target to target.y + 50.0f, virtual SetVisible through HudUiElement slot 0x60, visible-only cameraNode = g_MainCamera, and particleAgeTick = (zOpt::GetReplicateMode() == 0 ? 1 : 0).

The native smoke verifies the non-SUB no-hit path shows a hidden emitter, restores root raycastability and DI flags, assigns cameraNode and particleAgeTick, and verifies the SUB-mode hide path leaves weather-specific fields untouched after the emitter becomes hidden.
No VC object-byte manifest covers 0x406610 yet, so tier S verification is deferred to a coherent Player camera/source-cluster pass.
